Name: The Wadden Sea
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
Ever wanted to go to a little vacation spot and walk around a little, letting the sun grace your skin? Maybe this mod is for you.

It adds a map based on the Wadden Sea at the coast of Germany, including some critters that live there and a restaurant that sells fish themed dishes(run by a local named Enno Oltmanns).

This mod was originally simply created to show some love to my origins and a place that is considered a [url=https://www.waddensea-worldheritage.org]World Heritage by UNESCO[/url]﻿. With an area of around 3,450 km², it is the second largest German national park.  Exposed seabed at low tide, where lugworms frolic and crabs crawl around, but the special habitat has much more to offer than that. Like a puzzle, salt marshes, mudflats and tidal creeks combine to form a unique ecosystem.

You can visit the restaurant 'Strandlust' to buy some fish themed dishes and talk to Enno for a daily Wadden Sea fact or stroll around outside and do some mud larking, finding little critters in the mudflats(in the artifact spots).

[b]Future plans
[/b]- Add some furniture the farmer will get when you collect enough of the critters
- Add some extra forage etc.
- Maybe add some more depths via events to tell more about the Wadden Sea[b]
[/b]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI, Custom Companions, Central Station, HxW Tilesheets and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Since it's a new location visited via the Central Station it should be compatible by default.
